title: Abbie's building skills and bands in Biloxi
summary: Talk about Abbie's handiwork and the Biloxi club scene.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: And Abbie was crazy. He's a great guy, boy. That guy can build more things. Did you see, were you in Biloxi?
Just one night to hear him.
See the thing he built there, that little diner in that house? He built that on himself.
I didn't see that, no. I saw the place over there they were playing there.
Oh, Barra Seeds. They're back there again.
No, they're a different place now.
No, they're back. Dixie just got a letter from them.
What's the name's going up for auction next week, Broadwater? Oh, the Broad. Well, the same guy as the manager, Love, Darling. What's his name? Love, I think his name is.
Well, they're back at Barra Seeds.
We'll get over there pretty soon to see him again.
